shop_default_desc: Select an item on the grid to inspect tactical specifications and checkout cost modifications.
shop_coop_upgrade_desc: COOPERATIVE UPGRADE:\nTeammates can pool resources to build stationary defenses. Upgrades persist on capture sectors.
shop_no_cash_contrib: You have no cash to contribute!
shop_insufficient_funds: Insolvent! Insufficient funds to buy loadout.

items.carbine_tier1_desc: Tier 1 Assault Carbine chambered in 5.45x39mm. Standard iron sights with a lightweight stock, offering high handling speed in close combat.
items.m4a1_tier3_desc: Tier 3 Assault Rifle customized with a 1p87 red-dot sight, custom muzzle brake, and vertical underbarrel grip-pod for superior recoil control.
items.m4a1_tier5_desc: Tier 5 Elite Carbine featuring a high-magnification R4T optic, tactical suppressor, and armor-piercing Tungsten-core ammunition.
items.medic_box_desc: Deployable field clinic providing rapid radius-based health regeneration and emergency trauma kits for nearby friendly contractors.
items.beacon_beacon_desc: Tactical transmitter allowing squad members to deploy dynamically from low-altitude air insertions directly over key objectives.
items.fort_aa_spawner_desc: Cooperative tactical emplacement. High-rate twin 35mm cannons designed to establish total airspace denial over FOB Alpha.
